set.body:
Three fields of docs/data/sherlock/timebase-repair.json remain silent under mutation (measured 2026-09-17). Each can be checked against the record itself:
- coordinateSystems[3].rowCount = 998 should equal repair.retainedRows, and inputRows - |repair.dropSourceRows| (1000 - 2).
- coordinateSystems[1].runs[0].ordinaryEndSeconds = 1419 should equal repair.offsetSeconds.run-2 and the run-1 boundary check's rawEndSeconds.
- sourceDerivation.sha256 (the upstream notebook hash) is verified by nothing. Either verify it against a pinned fetch receipt, or mark it declared-unverified in the record and in the evidence document.

Extend the existing internal-consistency test ("the repair record agrees with itself") rather than adding literals. Prove each binding with a mutation that applies (by JSON path) and dies. Related: bd-01M2WTGF981AY7RCN8QC42JSPT.
set.title: timebase-repair.json: bind the last three silent fields to the record itself, or declare them unverified
